subject.title: Feature: Telegram Reactions - Two-Way Support with Prompt Guidance

question: Should Telegram reaction prompt guidance remain controlled by `reactionLevel`, gain a separate `reactionGuidance` config, or be deferred until reaction-triggered/persistent feedback semantics are decided?
rationale: The requested feature adds a public config/default surface and prompt behavior that overlaps existing `reactionLevel`, so automation cannot safely choose the lasting product contract.

options.title: Fold Guidance Into `reactionLevel`
options.body: Use the existing Telegram reaction-level policy as the single source of truth and extend it with incoming soft-CTA text and notification gating if maintainers want the behavior.

options.title: Add `reactionGuidance`
options.body: Introduce the requested separate config only after defining precedence with `reactionLevel`, upgrade behavior, schema metadata, docs, and tests.

options.title: Defer Prompt Guidance
options.body: Leave the current prompt unchanged until broader reaction-trigger and durable feedback semantics are resolved in the related issues.

recommendation.title: Fold Guidance Into `reactionLevel`
recommendation.body: Use the existing Telegram reaction-level policy as the single source of truth and extend it with incoming soft-CTA text and notification gating if maintainers want the behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have both recent history in the channel prompt-policy path and prior maintainer-side triage on this exact issue.
